title: Never shy, and the boyhood backyard
summary: Albert says he was never shy but sometimes afraid, recalls walking the woods at night to meet his father, and describes his tiny childhood yard.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Have you ever been shy in your life?

Have I ever been shy? Yeah. The whole lot. Well, not shy but been afraid. Been afraid for a few times in my life. During my musical career after I got my band because I'm I'm glad we jumped in the gun now a little bit but I would like to to answer the question about being shy. No, I had no reason to be shy. I guess maybe I'm crazy that's what they say but I was no reason to be shy but afraid, yes. I could go in the woods by myself I'd go meet my daddy at Lake Punch and Train two o'clock in the morning go through the woods walk by myself had no fear of nothing and go out there and meet his friends and be right along with them until I knew I was just a little kid. Well, I've never been shy.
Well, tell me more about your backyard.

Well, I think we're going to have to go and look at this thing. It's amazing. I had a dream that my yard was an immense yard that I had to play in and when I went there yesterday and I looked at it it's the same way it was when I was a kid and I had a picture taking a lot of wash tubs with my horn when I was eight years old and there's no difference in the house and the yard but it's just about the size of a matchbox. to me one of the beautiful things about the areas around St. Bernard is that you still have the nice houses.
